title: Close-up Cow looking over Wooden Fence, 1950s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A close-up black-and-white mid-century snapshot depicting a black and white cow leaning its head over a thick wooden pen enclosure on a rural farm. The snapshot features distinctive scalloped deckle edges typical of photo prints from the 1950s. The reverse features a faint red photofinishing stamp reading 838H.
